mapper.select: SELECT c.clothes_id AS clothesId, c.name AS name, c.brand AS brand, c.price AS price, c.category_code AS categoryCode, c.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, c.wear_count AS wearCount, c.last_worn_date as lastWornDate, i.s3_url AS imageUrl FROM clothes c INNER JOIN ( SELECT ci.clothes_id, f.s3_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.clothes_id ORDER BY ci.created_at) AS rowrum FROM clothes_images ci INNER JOIN file_info f ON ci.file_id = f.file_id ) i ON c.clothes_id = i.clothes_id AND i.rowrum = 1 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT clothes_id as clothesId, name, brand, category_code as categoryCode, clothes_size as clothesSize, price, purchase_date as purchaseDate, purchase_url as purchaseUrl, description, wear_count as wearCount, last_worn_date as lastWornDate FROM clothes WHERE clothes_id = #{clothesId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 'Y'
SELECT ci.file_id AS fileId, f.s3_url AS url FROM clothes_images ci INNER JOIN file_info f ON ci.file_id = f.file_id WHERE ci.clothes_id = #{clothesId} ORDER BY ci.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE clothes SET name = #{name}, brand = #{brand}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, clothes_size = #{clothesSize}, price = #{price}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, purchase_url = #{purchaseUrl}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE clothes_id = #{clothesId}

UPDATE clothes SET last_worn_date = ( SELECT MAX(di.wear_date) FROM dailylook_items di INNER JOIN dailylooks d ON di.dailylook_id = d.dailylook_id WHERE di.clothes_id = clothes.clothes_id AND di.dailylook_id != #{dailylookId} AND d.is_active = 'Y' AND TRUNC(di.wear_date) < TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1) ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE clothes_id IN ( SELECT clothes_id FROM dailylook_items WHERE dailylook_id = #{dailylookId} )
